newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Dec 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Dec 2.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The emir of Qatar said he was willing to invite Bahrain's Emir Sheikh Isa personally to attend a Gulf Arab summit in Doha next Saturday. Bahrain has said it will not attend the summit due to a dispute with Qatar.
- Tunisia is to develop investment cooperation with Saudi Arabia and Kuwait, a study said.
- The United Arab Emirates' central bank said bank assets fell to 179 billion dirhams in the first half of 1996 from 181 billion.
- Jordanian tourism ministry halted work on seven projects and sacked 6,000 workers to conform with the 1997 budget.
